title: Smooth Flow
notes: Updates are quieter: click Update and the game reloads on the newest version. Afterwards a small note on the left shows what changed and disappears by itself after 10 seconds (or when you open anything). Full patch notes any time: Esc menu > Patch notes, or on the save screen.

Training Tower looks different every 5 floors (8 places like Crimson Depths, Blossom Shrine, Void Colosseum), mixes monsters from every gate, has an elite every 5th floor and a boss with a big chest every 10th floor.
NEW: AUTO ATTACK button in fights. Your hero strikes and blocks on their own. Together with AUTO FARM (skills) you can farm fully automatically.
Arena: after a win you go straight to the next hunter or the rank exam with NEXT FIGHT.
